'''Geslariena''' is a regional language associated with river-valley and agricultural communities in [[Imperial Rhovland]].

The extracted source places Geslariena primarily in [[Valdris]] and [[Morvak]]. It describes the language as tied to river communities, seasonal agriculture, navigation, oral poetry, and regional identity within Rhovland.

== Linguistic Profile ==

Geslariena belongs to the [[Valderic languages]] and uses the [[Valderic script]] for official or modern writing. The source also preserves a traditional ceremonial script called Riverschrift, but the dump's rune examples contain corrupted characters and should not be hardened into a final alphabet.

The source emphasizes evidentiality markers, noun classes, river terminology, agricultural vocabulary, and a flowing rhythm associated with river speech. Current drafts preserve those high-level traits without making a full grammar.

== Cultural Role ==

Geslariena is associated with the [[Geslariena Folk Ballads]], an oral tradition that preserves the history and values of river communities. These traditions are useful for understanding Rhovland as a federation of regional cultures rather than a single uniform court society.

Later source references to cultural academies and heritage institutes should be treated as citation context or post-1994 preservation work until their founding dates are confirmed.
